description: Phase 7 higher-shot mitigated direct-distribution validation for gr_affine_n4. This is a quantity-of-interest validation campaign, not an amplified-QAE campaign.
rationale: Phase 3 showed that mitigation improved gr_affine_n4 distribution TVD, Hellinger distance, L2 distance, and max cell deviation.
Phase 4 showed that the first Grover iterate remains biased, so amplified QAE is not the right next hardware target.
Phase 6 identified selected affine functionals as usable with confidence intervals or usable with explicit bias reporting.
The purpose is to reduce statistical uncertainty and test whether the mitigated direct-distribution functional estimates are reproducible.

selected_cases.label: affine probability law, 16 midpoint cells
selected_cases.purpose: Higher-shot validation of mitigated direct functionals I_p(f), especially upper_half and sin_pi_x.

stopping_rules: Do not submit amplified gr_affine_n4 k=1 or k=2 circuits as part of this campaign.
If upper_half remains inside the bootstrap or Wilson interval and error stays below 0.01, keep the direct estimator as the hardware workflow.
If mean_x or second_moment_x2 remain biased outside intervals, report them as functionals requiring bias-aware postprocessing.
